The '''headquarters''' of [[Quebe-Luxfause Systems/Legends|Quebe-Luxfause Systems]] was a large structure in the center of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The building was located in the largest intersection in town where [[Outer Curved Street/Legends|Outer Curved Street]] and [[Spacers Row/Legends|Spacers Row]] intersected.
